frontend-engineer.title: Frontend Engineer Interview
questions: Walk us through a recent frontend project you are proud of, and the specific impact it had for users or the business.
How do you approach making a complex user interface feel fast and responsive?
Describe a time you had to balance design intent with technical constraints. How did you decide what to trade off?
How do you test and debug your UI work before shipping it?
Why do you want to work on our product, and what would you focus on in your first 90 days?

backend-engineer.title: Backend Engineer Interview
questions: Walk us through a backend system you designed, and the trade-offs you made along the way.
How do you approach debugging a performance issue in production?
Describe how you design APIs, and how you choose between different communication styles.
Tell us about a time you improved reliability, observability, or reduced downtime for a service you owned.
Why this role, and what would you focus on in your first 90 days?

data-analyst.title: Data Analyst Interview
questions: Tell us about an analysis you delivered that changed a decision. What made it persuasive?
How do you validate that your data is clean and trustworthy before drawing conclusions?
Describe a time you had to explain a complex finding to a non-technical stakeholder.
Which tools do you use for analysis and visualization, and why do you prefer them?
Why this role, and what kind of impact are you hoping to make in your first year?

product-manager.title: Product Manager Interview
questions: Tell us about a product you shipped end to end. What was your role in each phase?
How do you decide what to build next when everything feels urgent?
Describe a time customer feedback changed your roadmap. What did you learn?
How do you work with engineers and designers to hit an ambitious deadline?
Why are you excited about this product, and what would success look like six months in?
